name: Nakazato Hikari
source:
Hikari is [url=/c12955]Kenji[/url] and [url=/c6893]Suzuka[/url]'s older cousin. She is somewhat quick-tempered and is a tomboy. Hikari may be annoying but she really cares for her cousins and [url=/c6468]Nanami[/url], and is willing to help them when they're in trouble. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamune_%28anime%29#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
